scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of uniform product law and spectral and orbital classification; included finite numerical diagnostics are not proofs. Relevant preceding theorems on positive expansivity and spectral blindness are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Unilateral complex Hilbert-space weighted shifts with real bounded zero-mean finite-period perturbations at size j^{-1/2}; the statement is not a general Banach-space or arbitrary-weight classification.
title: Variance-shifted expansivity trichotomy for periodic square-root weighted shifts
